name: Tamashi Hime
source:
A writer comes to a mountain onsen ryoukan in search of inspiration. There is no electricity there, but laptop suddenly starts up with a strange noise, and a girl appears on the display. As she disappears, heavy feeling starts to fill the heart, and various mysterious phenomena begin to happen.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位作家来到山间温泉旅馆寻找灵感。那里没有电，但笔记本电脑突然启动，发出奇怪的声音，显示屏上出现一个女孩。随着她的消失，心中开始充满沉重的感觉，各种神秘的现象开始发生。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
